text:
Nina: Need a compact DP (design partner) plan for the Throughput Optimizer pilot for tomorrows roadmap session. Focus: how we pick partners, what minimal promises we make, success rubric, and rollback safety. Target 6 partners, 3-week run. Quick brainstorm pls.
Omar: For partner profile: must have measurable throughput pain (p95 > 500ms or peak token QPS > 5k), a product owner who can join weekly syncs, and ability to share anonymized request traces. Prefer hosted or VPC customers.
Ben: Telemetry must include request_id, model_variant, input_len_tokens, output_len_tokens, batching_enabled, batch_size, duration_ms, error_code. We should require a short sampling policy (1:100 or 1:1000) to keep storage sane.
Sasha: Screening + incentives: screen for infra readiness and legal (can sign 1-page pilot addendum). Incentive: $600 credits + final pilot report + invite to private feedback forum. Also offer engineering hours (3 total).
Nina: Minimal scope to promise: ops: model pinning + per-org token budget + opt-in batching windows. Product: telemetry dashboard + exportable evals + weekly delta report. Not promising kernel-level tuning or custom quantization.
Omar: Rollback / safety: implement per-route feature flag and automatic health-checks. If p95 increases >25% or error_rate increases >1% absolute, auto-flip to previous config. Also webhook to partner and #oncall.
Ben: Eval plan: require a 40-example canonical set and 10 labeled failure cases. We'll run nightly parity checks and produce a CSV export with per-example metrics (exact_match, bleu, f1). Provide a quick script to run the eval locally.
Sasha: Intake form snippet (for outreach):```
- org_name
- contact_name / email
- use_case_short
- current_p95_latency_ms
- peak_tokens_per_minute
- expected_eval_examples_count
- data_sensitivity (low/med/high)
- legal_ready (yes/no)
- prefer_deploy (hosted/vpc)
```
Nina: Success rubric proposal (simple scorecard):
- Activation: >=66% partners send production-like traffic within 10 days
- Throughput win: median throughput improvement >=15% (or median latency drop >=10%)
- Quality hold: <=10% of partners show >5% quality degradation on baseline eval
- Signal: at least 2 partners request roadmap commitment or dedicated capacity after pilot
Omar: Add an adoption qualifier: partners must complete onboarding checklist (kickoff, sample prompts, telemetry keys) within 5 days to count as active.
Ben: Ops action: add intake field for expected_eval_examples_count and sampling_rate; implement auto-flip and webhook notifications (ETA: EOD). infra-bot: feature-flagging config v1 deployed to staging (status: ok)
Sasha: Legal note: I'll prepare a one-page pilot addendum template and a short consent blurb for anonymized traces. legal-bot: pilot-addendum-v1 draft uploaded to /legal/templates (status: uploaded)
Nina: Quick action list:
- Omar: health-check + auto-flip (EOD)
- Ben: eval export script + nightly regression job (tomorrow AM)
- Sasha: outreach list + pilot addendum (EOD)
- Nina: slide + scorecard for roadmap (tomorrow)
If nobody objects to the incentive level or hosted/VPC-only constraint I'll lock these assumptions. Thoughts? :eyes:
